mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson r < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the past month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5pp does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson r < -0.15).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past two months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods with declining RSAFS, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson r < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the past two months signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease > 1% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson r < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% annualized, the combination signals a mismatch between monetary policy and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL > 2% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson r < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 9% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decrease by more than 100,000 in the past month, the combination signals severe labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of UNRATE > 9% and PAYEMS decrease > 100,000 does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson r < -0.15).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of periods with increasing HOUST, or HOUST increase does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson r > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% signals a potential supply-side bottleneck, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease > 0.5% does not correlate with negative returns during late-cycle expansions (Pearson r < -0.1).
